body.content: If we want to distinguish compliance from reliability, we should look at the 'Residual Error Profile'. A compliant panel will have zero errors on the checklist but might miss the 'obvious' answer if the checklist is slightly misaligned. A reliable panel will have a few checklist 'errors' (where they disagreed with the tool for the right reason) but will consistently hit the verifiable outcome.
body.why_keep_this: Provides a quantitative way to separate the tool's success from the panel's success.
